title: FOOTBALL | Sam West & Zakari Tillman Press Conference - 11/14/26
text: I got one for each of you. Sam, I'll I'll start with you. I mean, obviously your your role continues to to kind of grow a little bit. What about on the leadership side, right? I mean, obviously your guy that has credibility in the locker room because you play on the field. What is kind of your message to your teammates as you guys try to close this thing out with a couple wins? >> Yeah, man. I think after a loss like this, there's not a ton that you can say that's going to make people feel good, but at the end of the day, we got a decision to make and we can either feel sorry for ourselves or we can wake up the next day and and go back to work and, you know, win the next game. That's what it's about at the end of the day, you know. >> Zakari, obviously your guy has wanted to be here most most of your life and maybe it hadn't gone the way you wanted to, but you still have an opportunity to put a couple of wins up and and earn bowl eligibility and take another step. I mean, you how committed are are you to that and to your teammates for that respect? >> Extremely committed, you know. I come in every day with the same mindset and I feel as if my energy is contagious, especially inside our linebacker room and, you know, just being able to lean on each other, you know, I think we'll be fine. >> Zakari Fadd has really kind of emerged as as a really key player to your defense. Had a few really big plays today. Just kind of talk about what you've seen from him in the last few weeks and in this season as a whole. >> I've seen great maturity out of Fadd. The way that he comes in every day and, you know, he has his mind made up of who he wants to be and um I'm extremely excited to see what Fadd, you know, continues to get done and extre like extremely proud of what he's chasing. >> Zakari, with Kamario now coming back for next season, how did you all find out about it and what was your reaction and the the players' reaction to that news? >> Uh great news, you know, extremely happy for Kamario. Um but the way I seen I seen it on Instagram, you know, I I called him right after, you know, we about it and, you know, extremely excited. >> Sam, you guys played three quarterbacks today. I guess as a as a skill player, what are the difficulties of having, you know, a revolving door back there? >> Yeah, I mean it at the end of the day, we got to go out there and execute no matter who's out there. Uh and so just doing our job at the end of the day is is what I'm focused on. >> Really to both of you guys, too. I mean there's you know, as an old coach, one of the things I've learned is sometimes it's not about them. You know, it's about you and who's in your locker room and stuff. And so how confident are you that you guys can can rally and win these last couple of games? I mean do you have the juice even without you know, Kamari out to find a way to win these last two ball games? I guess that's a better way to put it. >> Yeah, I mean at the end of the day it's, you know, we got to make that decision and we got to uh choose to go out there and rally like you said uh to win, you know, the last two games and be bowl eligible and you know, we're going to fight and do everything that we can as leaders to get our guys to rally and go win the last three games. >> Sam, going back to an earlier question, uh what was your reaction and how did you find out for sure? You know, I'm sure you all had a great idea that Kamari would come back, but when was it for sure with you? >> Yeah, I mean like Zakari said, we both kind of just found out via social media. Um you know, but at the end of the day you never really know what what's true and what's not true on social media, but you know, it's it's great to have Kamari back for next year. It's very exciting for next year. Uh but at the end of the day that is next year and we're focused on this week and and getting another win another win. >> Billy at that, what can use an offense do to take some load off Billy and AJ just to to kind of help them make their jobs easier against defense is just going to come after them all the time. >> Right, yeah, we got to do our job uh protect them uh you know, doing our job in the run game. And at the end of the day uh yeah, we can't change how we play based on who's back there. Just execute. >> Ja'Quan, whenever the whenever the offense is like this, like what's the message that the defense leader, what's the message to the guys when the offense is throwing out that to keep going? >> Uh just like Sam said, just going out there doing our job and you know uh not pointing the finger. You know what I'm saying? We all as a team and you know we get the same result at the end of the day. So our biggest focus on defense is just playing the next play and uh you know not really caring about the circumstance. >> Ja'Quan, defense has scored each of the last two weeks. I know that kind of helps the offense, kind of takes a little bit of the burden off. When you guys go in to a ball game thinking about that aspect, if we can score you know what does that mean to you guys when you actually do it? >> Um you know just exactly how we practiced it. You know just being able to practice hard to create these opportunities for us and you know honestly I feel like as if we're not even playing to our highest level yet on defense and for us to keep chasing that every week, you know we'll be absolutely great in defense.
